name: Weekly Agenda
description: A compact weekly agenda with a travelling day selector, time-anchored event cards and expandable meeting notes, including a considered empty day.

props.name: timezone
props.description: Display timezone for host-supplied local times.

props.name: days
props.description: Ordered days with stable unique day IDs and stable event IDs within each day. Date, start, end and timezone strings are host display labels, without parsing or conversion.

props.name: defaultDay
props.description: Initial day ID; missing or removed IDs fall back to the first available day. Empty data can arrive later.

props.name: onEventSelect
props.description: Synchronous notification with an independent flat event record on either disclosure activation. Day selection stays local; the host owns external actions.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
